notes.note: Brayshaw had the Jordon tag for much of the game before he was released late but he managed to be the top scorer for the Dockers with his 25 disposals. We aren't used to seeing him get the tag. Hopefully this doesn't become a trend
Brayshaw couldn't keep that hot run of 100+ going but he still was good with his 22 disposals and 8 tackles.
Andy Brayshaw was the star for the Dockers as he took 9 marks and had 29 disposals which resulted in his best score of the year and fourth 110+ in a row.
Great game for Brayshaw as this is three in a row over 100 as he is really hitting some great form. 35 disposals and 7 tackles as he was great through the middle for the Dockers.
Brayshaw was one of the best for the game with his 30 disposals and 9 clearances being the best for the game. Back to back in the 120s is a good sign whilst Serong is out.

Brayshaw continues his run of scores in the 90s with a 25 disposals performance. He did have the equal most clearances for the Dockers with 7. He isn't hitting those ceiling scores often enough for us.
This is now back to back in the 90s for Brayshaw he has been good of late and is on the edge of being one we may want. 26 disposals at 88% in the wet is a good result.
24 disposals for Brayshaw with 18 of them being effective. He also attended the most Centre Ball Ups than any other Docker. His Scoring is just too inconsistent for us.
Brayshaw still hasn't been able to string two 100+ games in a row. 22 disposals and 8 tackles for him.
10 tackles for Brayshaw for his best in the last three games. He was the main man out of the middle with Serong being tagged.
Brayshaw copped an early cork and it did affect his score with him ending on just 65. His scoring isn't at the level that we would like so he isn't one you want to bring in at the moment.

Brayshaw had a quiet game in the wet with no marks but 9 tackles and 19 disposals. The wet conditions affected his efficiency which was just 47%. He wasn't on our radar but this will see him off it for a bit longer.
This is two in the 120s for Brayshaw in his four games. We would just like to see some consistency for him to be a solid selection.
Brayshaw is still going to lose value so if he is one you are looking at just hold off still. He is also not scoring consistently high enough for us to be at the top of the shopping list.
Much better for Brayshaw with 39 disposals this week and a goal. It would be prudent to see another good score from him before bringing him in.
Brayshaw had an afternoon to forget with 4 free kicks against and just 14 touches. You can still wait a week before you have to trade him to ensure he doesn't lose money.
